title: Can Insilico's Drug Help Turn Back the Biological Clock? | The China Show | 9/8/2026
description:
“Bloomberg: The China Show” is your definitive source for news and analysis on the world's second-biggest economy. From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors unique insight, delivering in-depth discussions with the newsmakers who matter.

Chapters:
00:00:00 - The China Show opens
00:04:39 - Yen hits its strongest level since February
00:08:21 - Chinese oil buying at risk as crude prices climb
00:12:59 - Insilico study finds drug with anti-aging potential
00:28:35 - UBS' Yifan Hu on why she remains constructive on China tech
00:38:37 - Longsys' Cai Huabo on building a semiconductor memory brand
00:42:18 - Copper hits a record high amid mine disruptions and tariff tensions
00:48:49 - What does the yen's surge mean for the BOJ's rate path?
00:52:08 - Cigna Healthcare's Jason Sadler on the outlook for healthcare insurance
01:03:53 - Sapporo's Rieko Shofu on the impact of US tariffs on its North American business
01:12:22 - Insilico's Alex Zhavoronkov on building a pipeline of anti-aging therapies
01:26:43 - Is Hong Kong or Singapore better positioned to attract expat talent?
